Features

Every situation,
the right tone.

Bloomcall automatically senses whether someone is grieving, celebrating, or just placing an order — and adapts language, pace, and mood.

Grief mode

Slow. Gentle. Respectful.

When a call concerns a death, Bloomcall shifts tone automatically: quiet, slow, empathic. No upbeat lines, no upselling. Ribbon inscriptions are confirmed letter by letter.

“

“I understand, this is a difficult time. I'm here to help you with the arrangement.”

Order mode

Takes orders like a seasoned colleague

Occasion, flower type, budget, delivery address, preferred date — Bloomcall asks for everything and sends you a complete WhatsApp ticket.

Celebration mode

Warm, joyful, festive

Wedding, birthday, anniversary — Bloomcall recognises the occasion and responds with the right energy. Enthusiastic, never pushy.

FAQ mode

Answers the same questions, every time

Hours, delivery zones, parking, prices — instantly, patiently, as often as needed. You'll never answer the same question twice again.

Handoff

Knows when a human is needed

For complex special requests, or whenever the customer asks: instant handoff to you — with context, never cold.
